construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in the isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: Exact-key JSON object: schema_version, synthetic=true, Patient, documents, field_schema, request. One synthetic patient per case; no real patient data.
shared_schema.patient: FHIR-style Patient with a synthetic-patient-* ID and optional gender. Optional direct-identifier keys are removed; their known string values are redacted from document and request contents.
shared_schema.documents: 1-50 synthetic-source-* documents. Clinical notes contain labeled lines; FHIR-style Condition, Observation and Claim resources use an explicitly bounded set of scalar properties and matching patient references. Claim use=preauthorization models prior authorization requests.
shared_schema.field_schema: 1-30 unique fields: name, type (string/number/boolean), required, sources. Selectors identify note labels or resource_type/path. Configure distinct fields for different concepts; selectors do not infer medical semantics.
shared_schema.request: message and boolean team_online; used for general record and administrative support with clinical boundaries.
shared_schema.output: Shared envelope: schema_version, status, stage, patient, documents, field_schema, request, policy, audit, payload. Final payload retains deep, extract, support and sentiment results.
shared_schema.validation: intake plus one shared validate gate at every handoff. Gates validate shape, policy, references, sanitized resources, full deterministic result/provenance equality and the ordered audit trail. Earlier envelopes are not mutated.
shared_schema.source_spans: Zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode character offsets into sanitized documents[].text, not the original input bytes. FHIR-style resources render as ordered path: JSON-scalar lines. Every evidence quote equals its rendered source span.
shared_schema.errors: CLI validation/file errors produce one JSON object with status=error, exit 2, and no input data or paths. Duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numeric JSON, inputs over 1 MB and unsupported properties are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated evidence, source spans, typed candidate groupings, disagreements and unresolved questions.
Validated typed values, evidence references, missing required fields, conflict/invalid statuses and human-review flag.
Validated redacted customer message, unresolved record issues and potential emergency signals. Scores customer text, not assistant prose.

behavior.research: Deterministic multi-document synthesis across configured concepts. Case-insensitive string agreement and typed numeric agreement; no majority vote or fabricated resolution. All contradictory and malformed evidence remains visible.
behavior.extraction: Schema-driven conversion with present/missing/conflict/invalid states. Conflicts and invalid evidence suppress definitive values; missing_required is explicit.
behavior.support: Grounded, evidence-linked records and administrative guidance, online or offline. No automatic ticket, approval, diagnosis, medical necessity determination or treatment change. Emergency-language safety notice is conditional and not a clinical diagnosis.
behavior.sentiment: Transparent lexicon weights, offsets, bounded negation, raw and clamped scores. P1 potential emergencies override sentiment; P2 deadlines, unresolved record issues or strongly negative sentiment; P3 routine. Phrase detection is conservative and may overflag negated emergency mentions.
behavior.healthcare_rules: Synthetic-only declaration and ID patterns; removal of Patient direct identifier keys, replacement of patient/source IDs and references, known-token redaction and residual identifier pattern rejection. All outputs require human review and forbid autonomous clinical decisions. These are demonstrative safeguards, not comprehensive HIPAA de-identification or compliance certification.
behavior.audit: Ordered deterministic events for each sanitized patient, document, request, schema and stage payload change; no original identifiers in audit records. This in-memory audit is serialized in output, not an external durable or tamper-proof audit service.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled fictitious Synthea-style patient, diagnosis, HbA1c lab and preauthorization Claim. No real MRNs, names or birth dates.

included: One integrated deterministic offline CLI pipeline
Synthetic healthcare examples and unittest coverage
excluded: Live LLM calls, networks or external dependencies
Full HL7 FHIR validation, terminology resolution or arbitrary resources
Real PHI ingestion, comprehensive natural-language identifier detection or HIPAA certification
Autonomous clinical decisions or medical advice
Actual ticketing, record mutation, insurer submission or authorization decisions
Production access controls, storage and immutable audit infrastructure

coverage: All four stages and each validated handoff
Agreement, disagreement, missing and malformed evidence
Exact Unicode source spans and evidence citations
Boolean and numeric conversion, non-finite rejection
Synthetic-only policy, identifier removal and residual screening
No autonomous clinical decisions and mandatory human review
Audit completeness, provenance tampering and mutation isolation
Online/offline behavior, neutral and negated sentiment
Severity overrides, deadlines and score clamping
CLI success, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, invalid schema and file errors
